title: FancyZones Layout Editor reverts to Priority Grid after changing active template using hotkey

judgment.rationale: The reporter reproduced the behavior again in 0.83.0, so it was not merely an unverified initial report. No current-release confirmation or linked fix is present; verify the exact hotkey-to-editor state before proposing a change.
evidence: Original steps assign a hotkey to a non-Priority-Grid layout, apply it, then reopen the editor.
The author later confirmed the behavior in 0.83.0.
Pinned source has dedicated layout-hotkey editor tests, but their existence does not establish this case is covered or fixed.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for one current-version retest using the original sequence.

fix_assessment.rationale: Historical behavior is credible, but no current repro or code-path evidence establishes a new fix; do not claim it is resolved or propose a change before confirming it persists.

issue_context.summary: A hotkey-applied FancyZones layout was shown as Priority Grid after reopening the editor.
known_information: No linked fix or current-version result is in the snapshot.
inferences: The bug may have changed since 0.83.0; this is not evidence that it is fixed.
Test presence alone does not prove this editor-selection case is covered.
issue_context.analysis: Retest the specific persisted selection state before deciding whether there is a current defect.
initial_investigation: Read the complete report and its three comments; latest author comment confirms behavior in 0.83.0.
Located pinned FancyZones layout-hotkey editor tests; did not infer a fix from test presence.

information_gaps.information: Whether the hotkey-selected layout still appears active in the current FancyZones Editor, and the exact PowerToys version.
information_gaps.why_needed: The author confirmed the issue in 0.83.0, but that is historical; the snapshot has no current-release result or linked fix.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: On current release assign a hotkey to a non-Priority-Grid layout, apply it, reopen the editor, and report version and selected layout.

comment.body: Thanks for confirming this in 0.83.0. Could you retry the same sequence on the current PowerToys release and share its exact version? After applying a non-Priority-Grid layout with its hotkey, please reopen the editor and tell us whether that same layout is still shown as active. This will establish whether the old behavior persists before we suggest a code change.
